title: Specified data for conditional expression-tree shift transport
statement: Use the integral/system categories, realization package and independently labelled expressions of [lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization], [def-pur-integral-expression-occurrences] and the designated shifts of [def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data]. Define $s_e$ as reduction of the updated input followed by the actual variable-context slot comparison, with its endpoint equality transports, before total limit. Define TreeMapTransport as the conjunction of system and integral squares and the actual realization intertwining equations at both input families. A TreeGeneratorSelection chooses actual SynchronizedBasic witnesses [def-pur-synchronized-canonical-maps]; TreeSynchronizedPair is their closure under identity, composition with geometric independent admissible intermediates, unary contexts and tensor. TreeGenerators chooses these predicates for every two families. The local TreeGeneratorShiftLaws require the system square and realization intertwining only for selected basic witnesses whose selected variable contexts exist. Define the successive dependent updates for an ordered finite list, the corresponding ordered output shift functor, and the successive source and integral comparisons as composites of the single-slot comparisons. These are the existing explicit constructions, with the signed right tensor slot retained.

def treeSystemShift {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (o : Operations l E) {W : Over B} (e : IndependentExpression B I X W)
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left) (i : I) (r : ℤ) :
    e.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj
        (Function.update K i ((K i)⟦r⟧))) ≅
      (e.val.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K))⟦r⟧
